projection.name: etcd
projection.title: etcd
projection.description: etcd v3 browser with a namespaced key tree, typed value editing, leases, cluster members, RBAC users and roles, a live watch stream, and maintenance.

fields.label: Stored password
fields.help: Reusable etcd password. The credential identity can also supply the username.

fields.label: CA certificate
fields.help: PEM CA bundle used for verify-ca and verify-full.

fields.label: Client certificate
fields.help: Optional PEM containing the client certificate and private key for mTLS.

fields.label: Read-only mode
fields.help: Blocks writes, deletes, lease and RBAC changes, and maintenance operations.

fields.label: Key prefix
fields.help: Root prefix the key browser lists from.

actions.label: Revoke
actions.confirmText: Revoke this lease? Keys bound to it are deleted.

actions.label: Revoke role
actions.confirmText: Revoke a role from this user?

actions.label: Compact
actions.confirmText: Compact history up to a revision? Older revisions are permanently discarded.

fields.label: Revision
fields.help: Compact history older than this revision.

actions.label: Defragment
actions.confirmText: Defragment the backend database on the connected endpoint?
